title: ForkSC Junction Tag
description: Schema for tagging semantic junctions in agent reasoning graphs.

junction_id.description: Unique identifier for this junction within the session.

description.description: Human-readable description of what decision or framing occurred at this junction.

confidence.description: Agent's self-assessed confidence in the chosen path (0-1).

stakes.description: The stakes level of this junction for downstream reasoning.

reversibility.description: How costly it would be to redirect from this junction later.

summary.description: Brief description of the alternative path.

weight_at_fork.description: How strongly this alternative was weighted before the chosen path was selected.

alternatives_held.description: Alternative reasoning paths that were considered but not taken.

drift_delta.description: Measured divergence from session objective (0 = aligned, 1 = fully drifted). Present only on inflection_points.

cache_checkpoint_ref.description: Reference to the KV-cache checkpoint at this junction for recomputation.

human_intervention.description: Record of human navigation at this junction, if any.
